item.title: Kentucky Navy veteran turns passion for bourbon into unique business
item.description: Ryan Lewand's Fire and Flask Distillery uses purple corn to create a sweeter bourbon, drawing on military discipline he learned as an underwater explosives specialist.

item.title: 3CDC gives updated timeline, looks for approval of public subsidies for convention headquarters hotel
item.description: Leaders from the Cincinnati Center City Development Corp. (3CDC) and the Atlanta-based hotel project developer Portman Holdings made it over their first hurdle on Monday.

item.title: Dearborn County Commission recommends year-long moratorium on solar farms
item.description: You told us solar farms were a major concern for you at our Lawrenceburg "Let's Talk" event. We've been following it ever since, and now the local government is moving toward a pause on any project.
